bob.name: Bay of Bengal
bob.summary: Most numerical models (ECMWF HRES, NCEP-GFS, DWD ICON, CMC GEM, EC-AIFS, NOAA AIGFS) are indicating the formation of a low pressure system over southeast BoB around 12–13 November (NCEP-GFS later, on 14 November). All of them indicate intensification into a depression around 12–14 November, and ECMWF HRES, NCEP-GFS, DWD ICON, CMC GEM, NOAA AIGFS further into a cyclonic storm (NCEP-GFS up to VSCS). Regarding movement, they indicate movement towards the Bangladesh coast (NCEP-GFS, CMC GEM); towards the Andhra Pradesh coast (EC-AIFS) and towards the West Bengal coast (NOAA AIGFS), while ECMWF HRES, DWD ICON keep it over the sea till the end of the forecast. Thus there is considerable uncertainty regarding the formation, intensification and subsequent track of the potential system. Ensemble guidance: ECMWF ENS 96%, AIFS ENS 100%, NCEP GEFS 90%, NOAA AIGEFS 100% of members show a system.

arab.name: Arabian Sea
arab.summary: None of the models (ECMWF HRES, EC-AIFS, NCEP-GFS, NOAA AIGFS, DWD ICON, CMC GEM) indicates any significant system over the Arabian Sea during the next 7–10 days. Ensemble guidance: ECMWF ENS 14%, AIFS ENS 12%, NCEP GEFS 3%, NOAA AIGEFS 0% of members show a system.

legend: ECMWF: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (IFS HRES); NCEP GFS: National Centers for Environmental Prediction Global Forecast System; DWD ICON: Deutscher Wetterdienst ICON global model; CMC GEM: Canadian Meteorological Centre GDPS; EC-AIFS: ECMWF Artificial Intelligence Forecasting System; NOAA AIGFS: NOAA AI Global Forecast System; ECMWF ENS / AIFS ENS / NCEP GEFS / NOAA AIGEFS: ensembles of the same centres. LPA: Low Pressure Area, WML: Well Marked Low, D: Depression, DD: Deep Depression, CS: Cyclonic Storm, SCS: Severe CS, VSCS: Very Severe CS, ESCS: Extremely Severe CS, SuCS: Super CS. Times are DD/HH in UTC (e.g. 22/12 = 22nd, 1200 UTC).
